question: Does a base checkpoint hold a parseable action loop?
decoding: UNCONSTRAINED. mlx-lm has no grammar backend, and enforcing the shape would destroy the measurement. On CUDA, xgrammar makes the parse rate ~1 by construction; what transfers is the relative base-vs-instruct difficulty.
verdict: Base checkpoints ARE viable. Both Qwen3-4B-Base and -Instruct hold a parseable action loop without constrained decoding.

k3_derivation: max(0.03, 0.5 * 0.04) using the better of the base conditions

findings.finding: Qwen3 hybrid thinking is ON by default and must be disabled.
findings.evidence: Qwen3-4B-Instruct scored 0/3 parseable at 120 max_tokens; every generation opened '<think>' and never reached an action. 50/50 with enable_thinking=False.
findings.consequence: Disabled rather than accommodated: the spec's deliberation budget meters reasoning tokens and prices them against acting, which an uncontrolled provider-side thinking block makes unenforceable.

findings.finding: Qwen3-4B-Base ships a chat template it was never trained to follow.
findings.evidence: Detecting 'is chat model' by template presence chat-formatted the base checkpoint. It then echoed scaffolding -- bare 'assistant', 'system\nHere is the shape of a reply.' Clean-rate 0.06 chat-templated vs 0.88 raw; run-on 43/50 vs 3/50.
findings.consequence: Reversed the apparent conclusion. Chat-templated, few-shot looked HARMFUL to the base model (30/50 vs 46/50). Raw, it is mildly helpful (48/50 vs 47/50). The base-vs-instruct arm would have been measuring prompt formatting.

findings.finding: Parse rate alone overstates base-checkpoint quality.
findings.evidence: Base emits valid JSON and then runs on into unrelated multilingual text. Raw prompting: 47/50 parse_ok but 3 run-ons.
findings.consequence: clean_rate is tracked separately. Under constrained decoding on CUDA the run-on disappears, because the grammar terminates generation.

caveats: Measured on MLX at 4-bit. Absolute rates will not transfer to vLLM/CUDA; the base-vs-instruct ordering and the K3 formula are what carry over.
K3's threshold must be re-derived on the CUDA stack before Phase F, since constrained decoding changes the base rate it is computed from.
